cmds: chmod +x file
`chmod +x file` = make the file executable for its owner, group and others.
tar -xzf a.tgz
`tar -xzf a.tgz` = extract (x) a gzip-compressed (z) archive from file (f) a.tgz.
git stash pop
`git stash pop` = re-apply the most recent stash and remove it from the stash list.
df -h
`df -h` = show free disk space per file system in human-readable units.
du -sh *
`du -sh *` = show the total size (s) of each item in the current directory in human-readable form (h).
ps aux
`ps aux` = list all running processes with their owner, CPU and memory use.
grep -rn foo .
`grep -rn foo .` = search recursively (r) for foo and print line numbers (n), starting in the current directory.
ln -s a b
`ln -s a b` = create a symbolic link named b that points to a.
journalctl -u nginx
`journalctl -u nginx` = show the systemd journal entries of the nginx unit.
git rebase -i HEAD~3
`git rebase -i HEAD~3` = interactively edit, reorder or squash the last three commits.
rsync -av src/ dst/
`rsync -av src/ dst/` = copy src/ into dst/ in archive mode (a) and verbosely (v), only transferring differences.
ss -ltnp
`ss -ltnp` = list listening (l) TCP (t) sockets with numeric ports (n) and the owning process (p).
